exposure: Abnormal levels of second trimester hormones (Alpha Fetoprotein (AFP), etc.)
Pregnant women with normal karyotype but abnormal second trimester hormone levels (n = 46)
Pregnant women with normal karyotype and normal second trimester hormone levels (controls, n = 31)
Abnormal vs. normal second trimester hormone levels
cohort: 108 Turkish pregnant women with normal karyotype, divided into those with abnormal and normal second trimester hormone levels
finding: Pregnant women with abnormal second trimester hormone levels had significantly higher rates of preterm delivery and preeclampsia, and lower AFP levels in this group were associated with preeclampsia development.
